use nom::{Parser, IResult, character::complete::char, multi::many0};
fn parse(input: &str) -> IResult<&str, Vec<char>> {
    many0(char('a')).parse(input)
}
fn main() {
    let (remaining, values) = parse("aaa!").unwrap();
    assert_eq!(remaining, "!");
    assert_eq!(values, vec!['a', 'a', 'a']);
    println!("nom {} {}", values.len(), remaining);
}
